newsitem.title: USA: CKF Bancorp sets special $1.00 dividend.
newsitem.headline: CKF Bancorp sets special $1.00 dividend.

text.p: CKF Bancorp Inc said its board of directors has declared a $1.00 per share special cash dividend payable February 11, record January 29.
The company also declared its regular semi-annual dividend of $0.22 per share, payable February 10, record January 28.

It said the cash dividends were being paid as a result of the continued profitability of the company and its wholly owned bank unit. It said any future special cash dividends would be at the discretion of its board.
